subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw core expose per-agent plugin install/uninstall now, and what lifecycle/security contract must it satisfy before merge?
rationale: The PR changes public CLI behavior, persisted plugin install identity, plugin-code roots, and agent trust boundaries; automation cannot choose those product and security semantics safely.

options.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract First
options.body: Require scoped install identity, uninstall/update/discovery/doctor/docs/security semantics, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Product Review
options.body: Keep the PR open but paused while maintainers decide whether per-agent plugin installs belong in core and what guarantees are required.

options.title: Accept Install-Only Experiment
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept an install-only surface, but existing users would inherit known cleanup, update, and trust-boundary gaps.

recommendation.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract First
recommendation.body: Require scoped install identity, uninstall/update/discovery/doctor/docs/security semantics, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core plugin lifecycle/product boundary decision and steipete is the clearest product owner plus a repeated plugin install-path contributor in history.
